desc:
🦸 BECOME A HOCKEY HERO
Pick your hero and step onto the ice. Every hero plays differently, and you can unlock rarer ones from packs.

⚡ FAST-PACED 4v4 HOCKEY
Team up with friends, tackle, dangle and outplay the other team.

🎮 CONTROLS (PC | Console)
Shoot - Click | RT/R2 (hold for Power Shot)
Pass - Q | LT/L2
Lob - F | Y/Triangle
Tackle / Poke - E | B/Circle
Sprint - Shift | Hold L3
Call for Pass - R | X/Square
Awakening - G | LB/L1

⭐ Like and favorite for future updates!
